title: Seemed flimsy
text: Seemed flimsy. These were a bit disappointing. I could not believe how flimsy they seemed. They just really did not seem like they would hold up well. They were also a real pain to put together. It took me a while to get one lined up right and done. I would imagine someone who already has difficulty would find it impossible. For me, these just did not work.

product_metadata.title: Shoe Boxes Clear Plastic Stackable,12 Pack Shoe Storage, 13” x 9” x 5.5” Shoe Organizer for Closets, Easy to Assemble, Sturdy, Front Opening, Clear Shoe Containers
features: 👞【WATCH THE VIDEO】It takes only 3 steps and about 1 minute to assemble one shoe box. Please watch our installation videos on this page before assembling. As the saying goes: A beard well lathered is half shaved, it is so worth the time you put into.
👡【Sturdy & Stackable】Made of durable plastic material which is quite sturdy. They are stackable. Frames at the front and back make the shoe boxes pretty stable and hold strong when stacked.

🥾【Ventilated & Transparent】The back frame is designed with ventilation holes to allow air circulation and prevent odors. Due to the clear body, you can see the shoes without having to open the box. Keep your shoes neatly, and easy to find.
👟【Maximum Size: Men's 9, Women's 10】Each box Size: 13(L) x 9(W) x 5.5(H) inches. Suitable for men's shoes in size 6-9 and women's shoes in size 7-10, fits various types of shoes.

🩰【Flexible & Versatile】They can be placed in the closet and under the bed, or any corner of the room. Not only for shoes but also for clothes, toys, books, towels, tools, etc. Please contact us if you have any questions.
